title: New Weight Loss Drug Shows Record-Breaking Results in Clinical Trial
subtitle: A new medicine called retatrutide helps patients lose significant weight and improves overall health markers.

summary.en: A new weight loss drug called retatrutide has shown impressive results in a large clinical trial. Participants lost up to 25 percent of their body weight after 80 weeks of treatment. The drug also helped improve other health issues like knee pain and sleep problems. Researchers noted that many patients with prediabetes saw their condition disappear during the study. This medicine is expected to be the most powerful option currently available for treating obesity.
summary.zh: 一種名為瑞他魯肽的新型減肥藥物在一項大型臨床試驗中展現了令人印象深刻的成果。參與者在接受八十週治療後，體重減輕幅度高達百分之二十五。該藥物還有助於改善膝蓋疼痛與睡眠問題等其他健康狀況。研究人員指出，許多患有糖尿病前期的患者在研究期間症狀消失。此藥物預計將成為目前治療肥胖症最強效的選擇。

paragraphs.en: A new medical study has brought fresh hope to millions of people struggling with obesity. According to Ars Technica, researchers have published the results of a late-stage clinical trial for a new weight loss drug called retatrutide. The findings suggest that this medicine could be the most powerful formula for weight loss developed so far. The study, which was recently published in the New England Journal of Medicine, shows that the drug helps patients lose a significant amount of weight over a period of nearly two years.
paragraphs.zh: 一項新的醫學研究為數百萬與肥胖症對抗的人們帶來了新的希望。根據科技新聞網站 Ars Technica 的報導，研究人員發表了一項名為「瑞他魯肽 (retatrutide)」的新型減肥藥物後期臨床試驗結果。研究發現顯示，這種藥物可能是迄今為止開發出的最強效減肥配方。該研究近期發表於《新英格蘭醫學雜誌 (New England Journal of Medicine)》，結果顯示該藥物能幫助患者在近兩年的時間內減去顯著的體重。

paragraphs.en: The trial began in 2023 and included 2,339 participants from 131 different locations across 11 countries. To ensure the results were accurate, the researchers divided the participants into four groups. Some people received different doses of the drug, while others received a placebo—a pill with no medicine in it used for comparison. At the start of the study, the average weight of the participants was about 113 kilograms, and their average body mass index, or BMI, was 40. A BMI of 40 is generally considered to be in the range of severe obesity.
paragraphs.zh: 這項試驗於二零二三年展開，涵蓋了來自十一個國家、一百三十一個不同地點的兩千三百三十九名參與者。為了確保結果準確，研究人員將參與者分為四組。部分人接受了不同劑量的藥物，其他人則接受安慰劑——一種不含藥物成分、用於對照的藥丸。研究開始時，參與者的平均體重約為一百一十三公斤，平均身體質量指數（BMI）為四十。BMI 為四十通常被視為嚴重肥胖的範圍。

paragraphs.en: The results of the trial were very positive. Ars Technica reports that patients who took the highest dose of retatrutide lost an average of 25 percent of their body weight after 80 weeks. When the study was extended to 104 weeks, the average weight loss reached 30 percent. Even more impressive, more than one-third of the people taking the drug lost 30 percent or more of their total body weight. These numbers are higher than what experts usually see with other weight loss treatments, making this drug a major development in medical science.
paragraphs.zh: 試驗結果非常正面。Ars Technica 報導指出，服用最高劑量瑞他魯肽的患者在八十週後平均減去了百分之二十五的體重。當研究延長至一百零四週時，平均減重幅度達到了百分之三十。更令人印象深刻的是，超過三分之一的受試者減去了總體重的百分之三十或更多。這些數據高於專家通常在其他減肥療法中看到的結果，使該藥物成為醫學界的一項重大進展。

paragraphs.en: Beyond just weight loss, the drug also helped improve other health problems linked to obesity. For example, many participants suffered from knee osteoarthritis, a condition that causes pain and stiffness in the joints. The study found that knee pain was reduced by up to 62 percent in those patients. Additionally, the drug helped people with obstructive sleep apnea, a condition where breathing stops and starts during sleep. For these patients, the number of sleep apnea events decreased by up to 57 percent per hour.
paragraphs.zh: 除了減重之外，該藥物還有助於改善與肥胖相關的其他健康問題。例如，許多參與者患有膝關節骨性關節炎，這是一種會導致關節疼痛與僵硬的疾病。研究發現，這些患者的膝蓋疼痛感減輕了高達百分之六十二。此外，該藥物還幫助了患有阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症的患者，這是一種睡眠期間呼吸會反覆停止與恢復的疾病。對於這些患者而言，每小時睡眠呼吸中止的次數減少了高達百分之五十七。

paragraphs.en: The drug also had a positive impact on general health measurements. According to the data, patients saw improvements in their blood pressure, as well as their triglyceride and cholesterol levels. Perhaps most importantly, more than one-third of the participants had prediabetes when the trial started. Prediabetes is a condition where blood sugar levels are higher than normal but not yet high enough to be called diabetes. By the end of the study, more than 90 percent of those participants no longer had prediabetes, meaning their blood sugar levels had returned to a healthier range.
paragraphs.zh: 該藥物對一般健康指標也有正面影響。根據數據顯示，患者的血壓以及三酸甘油脂和膽固醇水平皆有所改善。或許最重要的是，超過三分之一的參與者在試驗開始時患有糖尿病前期。糖尿病前期是指血糖水平高於正常值，但尚未達到糖尿病診斷標準的狀態。在研究結束時，超過百分之九十的這類參與者不再有糖尿病前期症狀，意味著他們的血糖水平已恢復到較健康的範圍。

paragraphs.en: Because of these strong results, there is a lot of excitement and anticipation surrounding the drug. Many people in the United States are eager to see when it might become widely available. The demand for such treatments has been so high that it has even attracted attention from high-level government officials. Ars Technica noted that in June, reports surfaced that officials in the Trump administration helped provide special access to the experimental medicine to a 79-year-old individual earlier in the year. While the identity of the person was not officially confirmed, many people speculated that it was Donald Trump himself.
paragraphs.zh: 由於這些強勁的結果，該藥物引起了極大的興奮與期待。許多美國民眾迫切想知道它何時能廣泛上市。對此類療法的需求之高，甚至引起了政府高層官員的注意。Ars Technica 指出，六月份有報導稱，川普 (Donald Trump) 政府的官員曾在今年稍早協助一名七十九歲的人士取得該實驗性藥物的特殊使用權。雖然該人士的身分未獲官方證實，但許多人推測該對象正是川普本人。

paragraphs.en: As the medical community reviews these findings, the focus will likely shift toward how the drug can be safely distributed to the public. While the results are very promising, doctors usually emphasize that weight loss drugs should be used as part of a broader health plan. This includes eating a balanced diet and staying physically active. For now, the successful trial of retatrutide marks a significant step forward in the fight against obesity and its related health complications. Researchers will likely continue to monitor the long-term effects of the drug to ensure it remains both safe and effective for patients over many years.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著醫學界審視這些發現，焦點可能會轉向如何安全地將該藥物推廣給大眾。儘管結果十分樂觀，但醫師通常強調，減肥藥物應作為更廣泛健康計畫的一部分來使用。這包括均衡飲食與保持身體活動。目前，瑞他魯肽的成功試驗標誌著對抗肥胖及其相關健康併發症邁出了重要的一步。研究人員未來可能會持續監測該藥物的長期影響，以確保它在多年使用下對患者而言既安全又有效。

sources.name: Ars Technica
sources.title: Most powerful obesity drug yet: People lost up to 25% of weight in trial

quiz.question: According to the trial results, what was the specific outcome for participants who had prediabetes at the beginning of the study?

options.A: They lost an average of 30 percent of their body weight.
options.B: More than 90 percent of them saw their blood sugar levels return to a healthier range.
options.C: Their risk of developing sleep apnea was reduced by 57 percent.
options.D: They were required to stop taking the medication after 80 weeks.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第五段，研究指出超過三分之一的參與者在實驗開始時患有糖尿病前期（prediabetes），而到了研究結束時，超過 90% 的人不再患有此症，血糖恢復正常。選項 A 雖然文中提到過 30% 的減重數據，但那是針對整體減重效果而非糖尿病前期患者的特定結果。選項 C 是關於睡眠呼吸中止症的數據，與糖尿病前期無關。選項 D 文中並未提及需要停止用藥。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the potential impact of retatrutide on the healthcare system?

options.A: It will likely replace the need for physical exercise and healthy diets entirely.
options.B: It is expected to be available only to high-level government officials.
options.C: It may reduce the long-term medical costs associated with obesity-related complications.
options.D: It will cause an immediate increase in the number of people suffering from osteoarthritis.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第四段與第五段詳細描述了該藥物不僅能減重，還能改善膝關節炎、睡眠呼吸中止症、血壓及膽固醇等問題。由於這些併發症通常需要長期的醫療照護，可以推論該藥物能有效減少因肥胖導致的後續醫療負擔。選項 A 與文章最後一段醫生的建議（需配合健康計畫）矛盾；選項 B 是對文中政治八卦的錯誤解讀；選項 D 與文中提到的「膝關節疼痛減少」完全相反。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, the author writes that doctors emphasize that weight loss drugs should be used as part of a 'broader health plan.' What does 'broader' mean in this context?

options.A: Physically wider or larger in size.
options.B: More comprehensive and inclusive of multiple factors.
options.C: Easier for the average person to understand.
options.D: Less expensive and more accessible to the public.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境下，「broader」意指「更全面的、涵蓋範圍更廣的」。醫生強調藥物不能單獨使用，必須配合飲食和運動，這構成了一個更全面的健康策略。選項 A 是「broader」的字面義（寬度），在此處不適用。選項 C 和 D 雖然是正面的形容詞，但文章並未強調該計畫的「難易度」或「價格」，因此不符合語意。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the main point of the article?

options.A: The political controversy surrounding the distribution of new weight loss drugs.
options.B: A detailed comparison between retatrutide and other existing weight loss medications.
options.C: The history of clinical trials for obesity treatments from 2023 to the present.
options.D: The promising results of a new drug that could significantly improve obesity and related health issues.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。這篇文章主要報導了 retatrutide 這項新藥的臨床試驗結果，強調其在減重及改善肥胖相關併發症（如糖尿病前期、關節炎）方面的顯著成效，這是全文的核心主旨。選項 A 僅是文中提到的一小部分花絮，並非主旨。選項 B 文中並未詳細與其他藥物做比較，僅提到效果比一般所見更好。選項 C 誇大了文章內容，文章僅聚焦於這項特定研究，而非肥胖治療的整體歷史。
